# OAuth Setup Guides

> A searchable library of OAuth app setup and approval guides for developers building AI agents. Each guide gives difficulty, setup time separate from approval wait time, step by step guide, a review timeline card, an approval checklist card, blockers, agent vs human steps, sources, and uncertainty.

## Full guides

- [GitHub](guides/github.json): Easy, setup 30 to 60 minutes, approval wait none for standard OAuth app registration.
- [Slack](guides/slack.json): Medium, setup 1 to 2 hours, approval wait none for own workspace install, varies for public distribution.
- [Google](guides/google.json): Medium to Hard, setup 2 to 4 hours plus verification preparation, approval wait brand verification typically 2 to 3 business days, sensitive scope up to around 10 days in some guidance, restricted scope several weeks plus assessment.
- [Meta](guides/meta.json): Hard, setup 3 to 6 hours plus App Review preparation, approval wait varies by permission and review round, not confirmed as a fixed number here.

## Summary guides

- Microsoft, Notion, Salesforce, HubSpot, Shopify, Zoom, Discord, LinkedIn: summary cards in guides.json, not verified, expand with live generation and official docs before use.

## Machine readable index

- [guides.json](guides.json): full index, same schema as the human cards.
- [guides/github.json](guides/github.json), [guides/slack.json](guides/slack.json), [guides/google.json](guides/google.json), [guides/meta.json](guides/meta.json): one guide each.

## Optional

- Use live generation on the home page to create a draft for an app outside the library. Drafts are labeled Agent draft, Low confidence, and must be checked against official docs before use.

Airtable: guides/airtable.json - Medium, full guide
- [Claude](guides/claude.json): Easy, setup 15 to 30 minutes, approval wait none. Not an OAuth app. API key only.
- [ChatGPT](guides/chatgpt.json): Hard, setup 2 to 4 hours plus unknown trial wait, approval wait unknown. Sign in with ChatGPT, limited trial for commercial apps.
- [Composio](guides/composio.json): Medium, setup 30 to 60 minutes managed, 1 to 2 hours custom, approval wait none in Composio itself. Auth config, not a provider OAuth app.
